bullets.text: People in Pallikaranai face flood fears due to the government decision to build a retaining wall around the marshland, which the office should monitor.
Residents in Minjur staged a midnight road roko protest over severe power cuts, and the office should track local electricity supply issues.
Police exhumed the body of a 19-year-old boy murdered and buried near Pulicat beach and detained two suspects, and the office should watch the investigation.

Southern Railway revised suburban train services on the Central to Arakkonam and Sullurupeta sections starting November 1, which the district team should track.
Sriharikota rocket launch preparations led to a fishing ban for Thiruvallur district fishermen, and the office should monitor compliance and community impact.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay ordered financial assistance of up to thirty thousand rupees or fifty percent for persons with disabilities to buy AI-enabled assistive devices.
Digital Bharat Nidhi and TANFINET signed an agreement to utilize the BharatNet network to expand rural broadband access across Tamil Nadu.
Larsen and Toubro broke ground on a new fifty-two megawatt data center in Tamil Nadu through its cloud and data center unit Vyoma.AI.
The Tamil Nadu government approved six hundred eighty road and civic projects worth one hundred thirty-one crore rupees, including the Gateway of Chennai beautification.
The state sanctioned twenty-two hundred infrastructure projects focusing on roads and water supply across urban and rural local bodies at two hundred thirty-eight point five crore rupees.
